read_pass: T-0974: visual reading of the whole scan, native-resolution block crops, a labelled crop for each of 31 totals, and enlarged headings, footings and uncertain cells. Local image derivatives were used for inspection only and are not committed.

column_geometry.method: Printed headings read against their own rules. read_census_continuation.py refuses this leaf with no industry run bracketed by TOTAL and PENSIONERS. Its vertical_rules function was applied in 300 px bands at cover 0.45 instead; only the boundaries confirmed by the headings are retained here. A profile candidate at 1539..1551 lies inside TOTAL and is not an industry boundary. This is the existing T-0761 limitation, not a change to the reading tool.

line_index.method: Centres assigned to the 31 visible total entries in order, not to every connected component. The tool's fixed x window produces 34 groups at dy=55 (35 at 35/45, 32 at 65, 25 at 75): separated caps and bowl fragments are not extra households. Crop boxes record the visual assignment. The industry entries independently align with these row centres.

blank_convention: null with state blank means no written entry. null with alternatives or state unresolved_mark means inspected but unresolved. Blank cells are not asserted as enumerated zeros.

deaf_dumb_blind_insane.exception: white blind, line 30, recorded on that line; the other visible cells and the footings contain no legible entry.

schools.first_seven_columns: blank: universities/colleges, students, academies/grammar schools, their scholars, primary/common schools, their scholars, scholars at public charge; body and footings inspected
schools.illiteracy_column: unread: the eighth, narrow column is compressed into the binding/facing-page boundary. Its visible sliver does not justify declaring the hidden area blank.

footer_as_read.note: Four written footings, read from the enlarged footer. TOTAL is 1, 7, 9: the third figure has a head loop and a descending tail, unlike the baseline sweep of the professions 2. This confirms the inventory's 179.

total.note: The bounds depend on the listed visual alternatives; they are not an independent population estimate. Four different assignments can reach 179. Arithmetic cannot decide which separated-stroke cell is 11 rather than 4, so none is silently filled.

pairing_test.rule: T-0642/T-0656: require both household line count and printed population to agree; a sequence screen is additional evidence, never permission to rewrite the scan.
